documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: Uniparts India reported Q4 FY26 revenue growth of ~31% year-on-year and 21% full-year revenue growth over FY25, supported by the turning global agriculture and construction equipment cycle. EBITDA margin for Q4 FY26 stood at 24% while full-year EBITDA margin reached 22%. The company continues to be net debt-free with a net cash position of INR 160 crores as of March 2026. Management expects FY27 growth to be in line with FY26, driven by order book execution and new business wins exceeding INR 225 crores over the trailing 12 months.

guidance.claim: Uniparts expects Q1 FY27 performance to be sequentially in line with Q4 FY26.
guidance.quote: Therefore, sequentially, we expect Q1 to be in line with Q4.

guidance.claim: Management expects the second half of FY27 to be stronger than the first half.
guidance.quote: And overall, we expect second half of FY27 to be stronger than the first half of '27.

guidance.claim: Uniparts expects full-year growth in FY27 to match the growth rate delivered in FY26.
guidance.quote: Overall, we do expect the growth in FY27 to be in line with what it was in FY26, supported by an improving industry cycle, execution of recent business rewards and wins and a gradual recovery across the end markets.

demand_outlook.claim: North American construction equipment demand is expected to continue growing in FY27, with the second half being stronger than the first half.
demand_outlook.quote: In North America, customers' commentary and industry data point to continued growth in FY27 for construction equipment, with demand expected to gradually strengthen through the year and the second half being better than the first half.

demand_outlook.claim: European construction equipment markets passed their cyclical low with early recovery signs in Q4 FY26.
demand_outlook.quote: Specifically coming to Europe, the construction equipment market appears to have passed its cyclical low with early signs of recovery becoming more visible in quarter 4 of '26.

demand_outlook.claim: The North American small agriculture market is projected to grow by approximately 5% in FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Overall, the segment is poised for approximately 5% growth in FY27, in line with industry estimates.

demand_outlook.claim: Industry volumes for large tractors in North America continue to decline in the mid-to-high teens year-on-year.
demand_outlook.quote: In North America and particularly, the industry volumes for large tractors continues to track down in the mid-to-high teens year-on-year.

capex_expansion.claim: Uniparts maintains its capex target at 2.5% to 3.5% of total revenue.
capex_expansion.quote: Madhur, our capex plans remain unchanged at about 2.5% to 3.5% of our revenue, and that is consistent, and we will not be deviating from there.

capex_expansion.claim: Rebuilding efforts for the fire-damaged finishing shop at the Ludhiana plant are scheduled to be online by the end of the year.
capex_expansion.quote: Right. So, Sunil, the efforts are underway to rebuild and to be online by the end of the year.

margins_costs.claim: Uniparts delivered an EBITDA margin of 24% in Q4 FY26 and 22% for full-year FY26.
margins_costs.quote: A brief on the financial position for quarter 4 FY26, Uniparts delivered an EBITDA margin of 24% and 22% EBITDA margin for the full year FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Management considers a 20% EBITDA margin to be sustainable over the full industry cycle.
margins_costs.quote: We have said consistently that 20% EBITDA is sustainable over the cycle.

margins_costs.claim: Freight and raw material cost fluctuations are directly passed through to customers.
margins_costs.quote: And I think as far as we are concerned, the freight and the raw material component of the cost is a direct pass-through to customers, right?

orders_capacity.claim: Uniparts achieved trailing 12-month new business wins exceeding INR 225 crores, representing over 12.5% quarter-on-quarter growth.
orders_capacity.quote: So if I talk about the strategic outlook, our new business momentum actually has gained meaningful traction with trailing 12-month business wins exceeding INR225 crores, growing over 12.5% over quarter-on-quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: Net working capital stood at 136 days based on trailing 12-month revenue as of March 2026.
orders_capacity.quote: Net working capital is 136 days on our trailing 12-month revenue as of March 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: Uniparts distributed a special dividend of INR 101 crores in Q3 FY26 and total dividends of INR 170 crores for FY26.
capital_allocation.quote: During Q3 of FY26, the company declared a special dividend of INR101 crores. In fact, the total dividend distributed for FY26 was INR170 crores, underscoring our commitment to disciplined capital allocation and shareholders' return.

capital_allocation.claim: Uniparts remained net debt-free with a net cash position of INR 160 crores as of March 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: The cash flow remains strong, and the company continues to be net debt free with a net cash position of INR160 crores as on March 2026.

risks_headwinds.claim: A fire incident occurred at the Ludhiana facility finishing shop towards the end of Q3 FY26.
risks_headwinds.quote: As communicated previously, towards the end of quarter 3, one of our facilities in Ludhiana experienced a fire incidents in the finishing shop.

risks_headwinds.claim: Implementation of the new wage code in November 2025 created a INR 3.4 crores impact on profitability.
risks_headwinds.quote: This performance actually accounts for INR3.4 crores impact on profitability due to the new wage code introduced in November 2025.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical escalation in West Asia in March introduced supply chain uncertainty and increased input costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: In March, a fresh escalation in West Asia introduced supply chain uncertainty that required swift action.

management_commitments.claim: Uniparts expects FY27 growth to be in line with the growth achieved in FY26.
management_commitments.quote: Overall, we do expect the growth in FY27 to be in line with what it was in FY26, supported by an improving industry cycle, execution of recent business rewards and wins and a gradual recovery across the end markets.

management_commitments.claim: Uniparts expects performance in H2 FY27 to be stronger than H1 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: And overall, we expect second half of FY27 to be stronger than the first half of '27.
